messages:
Nora H.: quick summary from this morning's bring-up of argo9b-int6 vs int8 on GTN multi-turn slices. found a small but consistent recall dip for long-context flows. link: https://bench.internal/argo/4309 :mag:
Diego M.: paste topline pls
Nora H.: sample n=4.5k (long-history slice). recall@5: int8=0.788, int6=0.771 (delta -0.017 abs, -2.16% rel). p50 latency: int8=180ms, int6=135ms. cost/1k: int6=$0.14, int8=$0.20.
Sana R.: that latency delta is nice for int6. product asks: what if we route only very-long-history requests to int8? estimate ~9% of tokens.
Nora H.: quick calc: baseline 110M tokens/mo = 110k * 1k tokens. all int6 = 110k*$0.14 = $15,400/mo. all int8 = 110k*$0.20 = $22,000/mo. routing 9% -> int8: int8_tokens=9.9k,int6_tokens=100.1k. cost = 100.1k*$0.14 + 9.9k*$0.20 = $14,014 + $1,980 = $15,994 -> +$594/mo (~3.86% uplift).
Diego M.: small cost. quality uplift for long-history should be near full gap recovery if we route the exact slice. recommend staged holdback: 0.5% -> 3% -> 9% for long-history only. Add synthetic probe traffic to validate.
Sana R.: also ask about cheaper mitigations: KV-last2 FP16 ablation?
Nora H.: ran kv-last2 FP16 ablation: argo-int6-kvfp16-last2 recovered ~55% of the recall gap (recall@5 -> 0.782). latency similar, infra overhead minimal. bench artifacts: s3://bench/argo/4309/ablation.zip
bench-bot: run recorded run_id=4309, commit=ef4b2c, variants=[argo9b-int8,argo9b-int6,argo9b-int6-kvfp16-last2]. diff report at s3://bench/argo/4309/diff.html
Diego M.: Proposed plan: enable kv-last2 FP16 for history_tokens>2000 as a low-cost global mitigation, then run a 0.5% canary routing long-history to int8 concurrently to validate end-to-end user signal. If delta persists, expand routing to 3% then 9%.
PM-Bot: Product note: target is <1.5% net recall regression vs current prod. Any cost >6% needs PM sign-off.
Nora H.: rough projected outcomes: kv-last2 alone -> reduces overall recall gap by ~1.0% absolute (gap halves). kv+0.5% routing -> expected net recall regression <0.8% and cost delta <1%.
Diego M.: ops notes: need dashboard panels: recall@5 by history bucket (0-1k,1k-2k,2k+), p50/p95 latency, token burn delta, and a random 40-case diff set. Also add economic rollback alert if cost >6% in 24h.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled on request: window 2026-09-14T04:00:00Z -> 2026-09-14T06:00:00Z. canary_id=canary-argo-4309. Owner=@Nora H.
Sana R.: ok, product will review the dashboard after the 0.5% canary. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
